journey.name: Lift: what a program works
journey.description: A built-in program's sheet before following it: a week of it as a balance of sets per muscle group, and the groups it leaves out named under the bars. Then a built-in followed, its first day done, made yours: a copy opened in the editor, a week longer, saved and followed on from day 2. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: Tap "Follow a program", scroll to "Full body for beginners" and tap it
Verify that the sheet shows "Full body for beginners", its summary, and under it "Balance" with "Sets in a week"
Verify that the bars read "Chest", "Shoulders", "Back", "Arms", "Core", "Glutes and hamstrings" and "Quads and calves", the chest's empty, with "Worked most" and "Assisted" under them
Verify that "Nothing in a week for: Chest" is shown under the bars, and "Day 1" and "Day 2" follow
Swipe the sheet away, scroll to "Goblet squat and row", tap it, then tap "Follow this program"
Verify that the Lift tab shows "Day 1 of 8 · week 1"; tap "Start day 1", log one set, tap "Finish" and then "Done"
Verify that the Lift tab shows "Day 2 of 8 · week 1"; tap "Change program", scroll to "Goblet squat and row" and tap it
Verify that the sheet shows "Following" and, under "Days done and left", "Make it yours"; tap "Make it yours"
Verify that the editor shows "New program", the name "Goblet squat and row (yours)", "You're following it: your copy carries on from day 2." and the blocks "Goblet squat" and "Row" with "(10–15)"
Tap "+" beside "Weeks" so it reads 5, then tap "Save program"
Verify that Programs lists "Goblet squat and row (yours)" under "Your programs", checked as followed; go back
Verify that the Lift tab shows "Day 2 of 10 · week 1"
